_note: DECONFLICT Aura-background scenes (aura-background spec, 8 scenes across Intaglio/Guilloche/Tactile). Master color = gradientConfig.colors. Password injected at POST time.

scenes.title: Waves Engraved Navy Banknote Lines
scenes.short_description: Fine parallel navy line-field on frost, evoking banknote engraving.
scenes.long_description: Many thin navy/cobalt wave layers on a frost field — the parallel-line engraving substrate (spec 1.1). Carries the vector intaglio print on top via multiply.

scenes.title: Simple Frost Engraved Paper Substrate
scenes.short_description: Subtle currency-paper grain for engraved security-print overlays.
scenes.long_description: Flat frost gradient + grain + light vignette — the safest text-friendly base to overlay crisp SVG intaglio/guilloché (spec 1.2). No fluted glass.

scenes.title: ParticleRing Guilloche Frost Security Medallion
scenes.short_description: Faint concentric medallion motion behind crisp vector guilloché.
scenes.long_description: Concentric radial particle motion echoes a rosette without trying to be one; fluted glass adds behind-security-glass depth (spec 2.1). Keep it quiet under the vector lacework.

scenes.title: Waves Lathe Frost Security Tint
scenes.short_description: Whisper-quiet animated lathe-work tint for document backgrounds.
scenes.long_description: Low-amplitude waves at low contrast = the faint lathe-work tint printed across a certificate (spec 2.2). Sits full-bleed behind document content with vector guilloché frames on top.

scenes.title: ParticleRing Guilloche Navy Sealed Medallion
scenes.short_description: Dark premium medallion backdrop for a sealed-document hero.
scenes.long_description: The medallion idea, dark and richer, for a premium fold (spec 2.3). Print the vector seal in frost/silver on top via screen. Drop fluted segments to 48 on mobile.

scenes.title: Ribbon Foil Cobalt Holographic Security
scenes.short_description: Cursor-reactive cobalt–violet foil shimmer for premium headers.
scenes.long_description: Flowing cobalt→violet→silver ribbon sheets under fluted glass on a frost substrate — the foil/holographic material (spec 3.1). Text over foil needs a frost scrim.

scenes.title: Liquid Metallic Navy Molten Foil Cinematic
scenes.short_description: Dark molten-metal hero for the landing fold.
scenes.long_description: Navy→cobalt→silver metaballs + fluted glass + grain on deep ink (spec 3.2). Desktop-first; below 768px drop fluted segments to 48 or disable.

scenes.title: Aurora Holographic Navy Iridescent Shimmer
scenes.short_description: Cool iridescent light shimmer for a holographic foil hero.
scenes.long_description: Cool light-ribbons (hue 218–262°, never toward orange) for a holographic foil glow (spec 3.3). Fluted glass + grain. Desktop-first.
